run.summary: INFEASIBLE AS STATED: inside the goal's own limits the openings held bring at most $2,400 of the $3,000 still needed, even with every buyer agreeing at the top price. To make it supportable, capital: allow the goal to commit at least $225, what the lots that reach the target need at once; or deadline: move the deadline to at least 20 days from now, when enough lots have settled; or target: lower the target to about $2,400, the most the openings held bring with every buyer agreeing at the top price. The conclusion covers the openings held; markets nobody has counted are not ruled out, so Brain keeps searching for openings outside them.
